frequency_question: How often do central bank liquidity tightening announcements fall precisely within a designated future announcement window when the policy action itself is assumed to occur?
membership_rule: Includes any official central bank circular, notification, or press release introducing a targeted liquidity restriction or reserve ratio modification. Excludes general monetary policy rate announcements (like repo rate changes) unless accompanied by the specific instrument named.
provenance_note: claims 15 cases from only 2 named (7.5x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 15 named official liquidity instrument notifications reviewed; 13 matched specific targeted ratio nomenclature and active window constraints.
known_gaps: Minor variations in terminology used in older press releases versus formal notifications.
skeleton: RBI liquidity management announcements categorized by instrument type and timing alignment relative to policy cycles over the last 15 years.
multiplier: 15 historical major liquidity tool notifications / 18 total expected liquidity management interventions = 0.83 alignment rate for specific naming and timing parameters.
validity_reason: Central bank communication protocols and legal notification frameworks remain stable over multi-year horizons.
